decisions.reason: Because this glass flake spraying system extends the firm's core coating equipment, has stayed on the website for two years, and shows no clear failure signal, management would likely continue it rather than admit a mistaken launch.

This injection pump is close to the established offer, has its own page in both years, and the prior testing effort increases sunk-cost and justification pressures, so management is likely to persist with it.
As a multi-model product line built on proven air motors and the firm's existing pump business, it reflects substantial commitment with limited evidence of problems, making withdrawal unlikely.

Although somewhat more adjacent than the pump products, the dedicated website presence and its fit with the firm's digitalization direction make management likely to retain it and explain any weak uptake as temporary.

This newer hydraulic two-component spraying system has the least public history, so it is somewhat easier to stop, but its closeness to the core business still makes continued backing more likely than withdrawal.
